skill_name: Describe the habits of a hummingbird.
workflow: Hummingbirds are small and colorful birds known for their curiosity and agility. They have slender, pointed bills adapted for probing flowers for nectar and for catching insect prey on the fly. They have strong, rapid wings for hovering and for flying long distances. They usually mate for life and build small, cup-shaped nests made from spider webs and down.
